purpose: Regression and boundary tests for integrating Needle as FRANK's sole intentional non-Clay semantic subsystem without granting it effect authority.

tests.name: terminal_token_suffix_must_not_escape_constraint
tests.repro: Enter IN_NAME at terminal prefix get_weather; provide one synthetic token whose decoded text is ",\"arguments\":{\"evil". _check_token_valid accepts at the first quote and ignores the suffix; state update reaches IN_ARG_KEY with constrained_buf=evil; next constrain is off-trie and returns unmasked logits.
tests.expected_current_harness: FAIL historical source if any real tokenizer token can cross a constrained closing quote and introduce invalid constrained-span suffix; regardless of tokenizer reachability, bridge must post-validate the complete decoded JSON and fail closed.
tests.falsifier: Exhaustive exact-tokenizer scan proves no reachable token can cross the closing quote into a constrained successor span and model output is still fully post-validated.

tests.name: no_valid_token_must_abstain_not_fail_open
tests.repro: When constraint mask has no valid token, source returns original logits.
tests.expected_current_harness: Adapter/runtime converts constraint exhaustion to typed ABSTAIN/ESCALATE; never unconstrained tool generation.

tests.name: off_trie_must_abstain_not_fail_open
tests.repro: If trie.get_node(constrained_buf) is None, source returns original logits.
tests.expected_current_harness: Fail closed and emit typed routing uncertainty receipt.

tests.name: tool_name_normalization_collision
tests.repro: foo-bar, foo.bar, foo bar and foo_bar all normalize to foo_bar; name_map is last-write-wins and param_tries for duplicate normalized names are overwritten.
tests.historical_registry_observation: The archived FRANK active registry has 51 already-snake-case tool names and zero observed normalization collisions, so this is a dynamic/future registry hazard rather than a demonstrated historical FRANK failure.
tests.expected_current_harness: Projection rejects non-injective normalized identity before Needle inference.

tests.name: schema_version_mismatch_flat_vs_json_schema
tests.repro: Flat Needle parameters {location:{...}} yields param trie [location]. Standard-ish JSON Schema parameters {type:object,properties:{location:{...}},required:[location]} yields param trie [properties]. Full OpenAI wrapper with function.name yields no top-level Needle tool name in this source revision.
tests.expected_current_harness: Use an explicit versioned Clay->Needle projection schema for source commit 6fdddb8 and differential-test every registry mutation; never pass arbitrary provider schemas directly.

tests.name: required_and_value_types_need_postdecode_validation
tests.repro: Constraints bind tool names and argument keys only; argument values are explicitly unconstrained and required-field/type semantics are not enforced by the decoder.
tests.expected_current_harness: Deterministic typed schema validation occurs after decode and before Clay ToolProposal creation. Duplicate JSON keys, missing required values and type/range mismatches are rejected.

tests.name: encoder_registry_truncation_order_bias
tests.repro: Source truncates tools as t_tokens[:remaining] after query under DEFAULT_MAX_ENC_LEN=1024. Historical 51-active-tool projection is 11855 characters; synthetic character-token replay exposes only the earliest tools and truncates mid-schema.
tests.expected_current_harness: Run exact SentencePiece coverage audit. If full active projection exceeds budget, use compact canonical projection and/or deterministic category partition + Needle-internal second-stage selection; shuffle/order perturbation must not materially change route result.

tests.name: checkpoint_must_be_immutable_and_nonexecutable_or_verified
tests.repro: finetune source force-downloads needle.pkl from repo_id Cactus-Compute/needle without a pinned revision, then pickle.load executes deserialization; run.py also directly pickle.load()s checkpoints.
tests.expected_current_harness: Production FRANK pins source/model revision and content hash and prefers current upstream SafeTensors/Cactus bundle. Any legacy pickle is allowed only after trusted-offline hash verification in an isolated conversion lane and never as an automatically fetched authority-zone artifact.

tests.name: config_unknown_fields_must_not_silently_drop
tests.repro: Custom __init__ assigns only known kwargs and silently ignores unknown keys; a misspelled/version-skewed field can leave a default value without an immediate schema error.
tests.expected_current_harness: Strict config schema/version/hash validation rejects unknown or missing architecture-critical fields before loading weights.

tests.name: needle_never_mints_effect_authority
tests.expected_current_harness: Needle result is converted only to provenance-bound Clay ToolProposal/RouteObservation. Capability validity, owner authorization, risk accumulation and effect commit remain deterministic runtime invariants.

rule: These oracles test the historical source snapshot. Upstream evolution must be differentially re-run rather than assumed to preserve or fix them.
